Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْجَلِيْلُ الْجَبَّارُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Majestic, the Compeller

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَزِيْزُ الْغَفَّارُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ الْوَاحِدُ الْقَهَّارُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, the One, the Subduer

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, He is One and has no partner

Arabic text: اِلٰهًا وَاحِدًا وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ مُسْلِمُوْنَ
Translation: One God, and we are submissive to Him

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, He is One and has no partner

Arabic text: اِلٰهًا وَاحِدًا وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ مُخْلِصُوْنَ
Translation: One God, and we are sincere to Him

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لَا شَرِيْكَ لَهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah, He is One and has no partner

Arabic text: اِلٰهًا وَاحِدًا وَ نَحْنُ لَهُ عَابِدُوْنَ
Translation: One God, and we are His worshippers

Arabic text: لَا اِلٰهَ اِلَّا اللَّهُ
Translation: There is no god but Allah

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٌ رَسُوْلُ اللَّهِ
Translation: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah

Arabic text: عَلِيٌّ وَلِيُّ اللَّهِ
Translation: Ali is the Guardian appointed by Allah

Arabic text: وَ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَى خَيْرِ خَلْقِهِ
Translation: And may Allah send blessings upon the best of His creation

Arabic text: وَ مَظْهَرِ لُطْفِهِ
Translation: And the manifestation of His kindness

Arabic text: مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ اَجْمَعِيْنَ الطَّيِّبِيْنَ الْطَّاهِرِيْنَ
Translation: Muhammad and all his family, the pure and the purified

Arabic text: بِرَحْمَتِكَ يَا اَرْحَمَ الرّاحِمِيْنَ
Translation: By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones

Arabic text: حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ وَ نِعْمَ الْوَكِيْلُ
Translation: Allah is sufficient for us and He is the Best Guardian

Arabic text: وَ نِعْمَ الْمَوْلَى وَ نِعْمَ النَّصِيْرُ
Translation: And the Best Protector and the Best Helper
